title: Request For Microproducts
description: A call to build useful microproducts instead of portfolio projects optimized only for hiring signals.

children.title: Playbook
children.description: A living collection of contributor-built modules for building microproducts that turn data into value, moving from shared foundations into the analytics development lifecycle: frame, build, and operate.

children.title: Plan
children.description: The planning layer of the analytics development lifecycle, organizing content around defining opportunities, understanding users, scoping microproducts, and analyzing whether an idea is worth building.

children.title: Frame
children.description: Validate whether a microproduct is worth building and feasible to deliver before execution.

children.title: Data Licensing
children.description: Access is not permission. Before treating a dataset as a product input, document the rights you have to store, transform, combine, serve, and commercialize it.

children.title: Modern Data Stack
children.description: Modern data infrastructure is not a list of products. Reason from product constraints before choosing a warehouse, orchestrator, or lakehouse.

children.title: Quality-First
children.description: How a modern approach to QA and spec-driven development helps ship quickly and confidently.

children.title: Build
children.description: The development layer of the analytics development lifecycle, organizing content around designing, developing, testing, and deploying microproducts through iterative implementation.

children.title: Build
children.description: Execute, validate quality, and deliver a reliable MVP through focused delivery workflows.

children.title: From Chat to Tickets
children.description: Chat is an interface; a ticket is a unit of work. Move agentic development from conversation history into bounded tickets that preserve intent.

children.title: Release Guide
children.description: A decision framework for releasing microproducts that informs prior phases of development.

children.title: Operate
children.description: The operational layer of the analytics development lifecycle, organizing content around operating, observing, learning from, and improving shipped microproducts over time.

children.title: Operate
children.description: Own distribution, learning, and iteration after launch so the product keeps improving.

children.title: Microproduct Deployment
children.description: GitHub stores the code. Vercel runs the application. For many web-based microproducts, that is enough deployment architecture to get a product into users' hands.

children.title: Authors
children.description: The people and organizations listed in the shared author registry for the docs.
